summary: Iteration 2 — all 4 new features verified end-to-end. Backend: 13/13 new pytest cases pass in /app/backend/tests/test_new_features.py (missed-money grand_total > 0 for seeded 10-day-old items, dispatch GET grouped by crew with 3 seeded assignments, dispatch POST creates + persists, checkin start returns first job, checkin answer with 'fail' keyword auto-creates failed inspection, final answer returns done=true with LLM summary, photo upload to Emergent Object Storage returns storage_path+url and is auth-protected, files GET works via ?token= AND Authorization header, missing/invalid token returns 401, chat/send with photo_url attaches photo_url to the created change-order draft). Regression: previous 14/14 in test_backend_api.py still valid. Frontend: Briefing card shows $5,050 missed money with '2 unsigned CO · 1 disputed BC · over 7 days' subtext, quick-eod and quick-dispatch buttons navigate correctly, /dispatch renders '4 assignments across 3 crews' grouped by crew name (Crew A, Crew B, TEST_Crew_Z from POST test) with times/notes, /checkin walks 3 jobs and shows LLM office summary on completion, Talk tab shows attach-photo-btn (PHOTO) next to HOLD TO TALK.

minor.issue: Chat log entry uses raw job_id: '[End-of-Day · job_xxxxx]'. The LLM summary then echoes those raw IDs instead of job names. Suggest inject job_name when composing the log_text so the LLM summary is human-readable.

action_items: OPTIONAL polish: In /api/checkin/answer, include job_name in the recorded chat log (e.g., '[End-of-Day · Riverside Apartments]') so the office LLM summary references job names instead of internal IDs.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py has grown to ~900 lines with the new features — recommend splitting into modules (auth, jobs, chat, uploads, dispatch, checkin, voice) before the next iteration.
/api/files/{path} correctly supports both Authorization header and ?token= query for tags on web, and enforces ownership via db.uploads.
Object Storage init runs at startup with EMERGENT_LLM_KEY; stale-key handling (503) implemented — good.
Missed-money cutoff uses UTC 'now - 7 days' — matches seeded 10-day-old CO/BC data.
Dispatch GET uses tomorrow's UTC window; this is fine for demo but could feel off around user midnight — acceptable for MVP.
checkin/answer detects 'fail' or 'inspection' in issues to auto-create failed inspection — worked as designed.
Chat send correctly attaches photo_url to the auto-created change order draft.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (all 4 new flows verified via mobile viewport Playwright)

seed_data_creation: Reused seeded demo data from POST /api/auth/dev-login (2 CO + 1 BC back-dated 10 days, 3 crew_assignments for tomorrow). Added 1 TEST_Crew_Z dispatch, 1 failed inspection via checkin flow, 1 change-order draft with photo_url via chat, and 1 1x1 PNG upload — all prefixed with TEST_ where identifiable.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run both suites: `pytest backend/tests/ -v`. New feature tests in test_new_features.py. Demo credentials in /app/memory/test_credentials.md (no password; POST /api/auth/dev-login). Web preview cannot open expo-image-picker native gallery — validate the /api/uploads/photo endpoint directly (a 1x1 PNG helper is included in test_new_features.py::_mini_png). Talk screen photo-attach button testID='attach-photo-btn', remove-photo appears when pendingPhoto state is set. Missed-money grand_total for seeded demo user = $5,050 (2800 draft CO + 1450 pending CO + 800 disputed BC).
rca_of_issue: N/A — no bugs blocking release. Only one cosmetic nit (raw job_ids in EOD summary text).
